name: AxBench
description: A large-scale benchmark for steering and concept detection in language models, enabling direct comparison of representation-based techniques such as sparse autoencoders, linear probes, and supervised steering vectors.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has gained attention in mechanistic interpretability and model steering research, but it is still emerging rather than broadly standardized.
notes: Includes training and release of SAE-scale feature dictionaries; evaluates multiple steering and concept detection methods.
